pages.title: Merry Christmas

approved_text: Wishing you a joyful Christmas and a happy New Year

pages.title: Robin at the Frosted Gate

Supply printing and folding guidance separately as a non-artwork deliverable; explain correct front/inside/back placement for A4 and US Letter printing.
